name: remind-pane
description: Reminders in a Claude Code pane: checkboxes, delete, an add field, a small stdlib-only CLI; optional delivery to Telegram

python.title: Python
python.description: The Python that runs the CLI (standard library only, 3.9+).

dataDir.title: Data folder
dataDir.description: Where reminders.json (your reminders, in plain text) lives. Empty: ~/.local/share/remind-pane.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA name for dates you type and see, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Empty: the system's.

telegramToken.title: Telegram bot token (optional)
telegramToken.description: Only for delivery to Telegram by 'remind.py tick'. Create a bot with @BotFather. Empty: reminders are only stored and shown in the pane.

telegramChat.title: Telegram chat id (optional)
telegramChat.description: The chat that receives reminders (your user id, after you have written to the bot).
